body:
RUN17's exact polynomial domain checks left continuity at accepted-step interfaces unresolved. A continuous residual estimate needs either explicit state-jump terms or a continuous reconstruction.

This PR adds the bounded RUN18 unit on the same saved first-birth B trajectory. It preserves the original atomic/geometry owners and all RUN17 data.

- Import VigilODE directed.rs unchanged, with its MIT license and pinned byte identity.
- Build a DOP853 degree-seven exact/interval adapter with num-rational 0.4.2 and num-bigint 0.4.6; include Cargo.lock, official dependency archives, source, binary and raw TSV/JSONL evidence.
- Find 431 nonzero depth-coordinate jumps at three interfaces, zero gas-value jumps, and define an exactly continuous, nonnegative depth reconstruction.
- Establish the repair-only positive-channel response factor beta = 9/288230376151711735. It is not a true-IVP or spectral continuum bound.
- Record the actual current VigilODE source readback and preserve the original 45/26-node DAG obligations.

Validation: 4 actual Rust tests passed; 5,911 exact cases match an independent Python reference; 5,911 right-endpoint values and 5,911 derivatives are included by the imported interval arithmetic. No native RHS, IVP, quadrature or historical m2 reruns in RUN18. One scoped independent review is preserved.

Science commit: 6c0ae2a2ba63d42e23c7b79f989fa64639f4c942.
Parent: RUN17 delivery 0e23addf4fefa69287d4626622bf97505677ea43 (stacked on #207).
All 130 changes are additions under research/atomic_nuclear_ssot_20261017/run18.

The next incomplete work remains an original-owner continuous interval RHS and a gas/depth error tube, including initial/event/source forcing terms. Main and production are unchanged. Delivery receipts will be added after clean Git and dual-backup readback.
